rollback: Promote (Vercel instant rollback) dpl_DdXpgtYvPQnxTTHHzE2HFANMW8n8, the cutoff build. It still ships the legacy route, and a promoted deployment keeps the environment it was built with (LEGACY_ENGINE=retired), so its legacy path stays off. Rebuilding that commit would not: LEGACY_ENGINE is no longer set, so a rebuilt cutoff build would fall back to legacy for refused Classical scenes.
The cleared plan cache was disposable: a restored legacy build re-plans on a cache miss. The rows are kept in this folder.

cleanup.emptyTable: Convex keeps an empty table after it leaves the schema, and the CLI has no table deletion (import --replace-all would clear every table). scenePlanCache stays listed, empty, on dev and production until it is deleted in the Convex dashboard.
